root.label: Indonesian airports reopen after Anak Krakatau ash disruption

events.label: Indonesian airports reopen after Anak Krakatau ash disruption

slots.name: airport reopening status
slots.sentence: Indonesia has reopened its main airport in Jakarta and four others that had been closed due to volcanic ash from Mount Anak Krakatau.

slots.name: airports reopened
slots.sentence: The five airports reopened on Tuesday after authorities cleared volcanic ash from critical infrastructure.

slots.name: travellers affected
slots.sentence: The disruption affected more than 340,000 travellers and approximately 2,900 flights.
